title: The Big Short: Inside the Doomsday Machine
author: Michael Lewis
summary: Michael Lewis tells the story of the few investors who saw the 2000s housing bubble and bet against subprime mortgage bonds, exposing how banks and rating agencies built the crisis.
readIf: you like financial storytelling with eccentric characters and a clear explanation of the 2008 crash.
skipIf: you want an economic textbook or a neutral view on the causes of the crisis.
